captionsSrc.zh-CN: 字幕资源地址，传入后默认显示字幕。
captionsSrc.en-US: Captions source URL; the captions are shown by default once set.

clickToPlay.zh-CN: 点击视频画面时是否切换播放与暂停。
clickToPlay.en-US: Whether clicking the video toggles playback.

controlsList.zh-CN: 控制栏展示的控件，默认展示全部。控件还要满足依赖的属性已提供才会显示。
controlsList.en-US: Controls shown in the control bar, all by default. A control also needs the prop it depends on to show.

crossOrigin.zh-CN: video 元素的 CORS 设置，允许的值为 anonymous 与 use-credentials，空串等同 anonymous。
crossOrigin.en-US: CORS setting of the video element: anonymous or use-credentials; an empty string means anonymous.

defaultPlaybackRate.zh-CN: 初始播放倍率，仅在挂载时读取。
defaultPlaybackRate.en-US: Initial playback rate, read once when the player mounts.

defaultQuality.zh-CN: 初始清晰度，仅在挂载时读取。
defaultQuality.en-US: Initial quality, read once when the player mounts.

defaultRoute.zh-CN: 初始线路，仅在挂载时读取。
defaultRoute.en-US: Initial route, read once when the player mounts.

height.zh-CN: 播放器高度，数字按像素处理，字符串原样使用。
height.en-US: Player height; a number is in pixels, a string is used as is.

markers.zh-CN: 章节标记，每项含起始时间 start（秒）与标题 title。
markers.en-US: Chapter markers, each with a start time in seconds and a title.

muted.zh-CN: 是否静音播放，仅在挂载时读取。
muted.en-US: Whether to start muted, read once when the player mounts.

onNext.zh-CN: 点击下一个按钮时调用。设置后且 controlsList 包含 next 时才显示该按钮。
onNext.en-US: Called by the next button, which shows only when this is set and controlsList includes next.

onQualityChange.zh-CN: 切换清晰度时调用，参数为所选清晰度的值。
onQualityChange.en-US: Called when the quality changes, with the selected quality value.

onRateChange.zh-CN: 切换倍速时调用，参数为所选倍率。
onRateChange.en-US: Called when the playback rate changes, with the selected rate.

onRouteChange.zh-CN: 切换线路时调用，参数为所选线路的值。
onRouteChange.en-US: Called when the route changes, with the selected route value.

onVolumeChange.zh-CN: 用户拖动音量滑块或切换静音时调用，参数为变化后的音量，静音时为 0；初始化不调用。
onVolumeChange.en-US: Called when the user drags the volume slider or toggles mute, with the new volume (0 when muted); not called on initialization.

playbackRateList.en-US: Playback rate options, by default 2.0, 1.5, 1.25, 1.0 and 0.75.

qualityList.zh-CN: 清晰度选项列表，非空时才显示清晰度控件。
qualityList.en-US: Quality options; the quality control shows only when this is non-empty.

routeList.zh-CN: 线路选项列表，非空时才显示线路控件。
routeList.en-US: Route options; the route control shows only when this is non-empty.

seekTime.en-US: Seconds a fast forward or rewind moves.

src.zh-CN: 视频地址。未设置时显示资源缺失提示；移除后 video 元素保留上一个地址。
src.en-US: Video URL. Without it a missing-resource message shows; removing it keeps the previous source on the video element.

theme.zh-CN: 主题，仅影响背景色，可选 dark 或 light。
theme.en-US: Theme, affecting only the background color: dark or light.

volume.zh-CN: 初始音量，取值 0 到 100，仅在挂载时读取。
volume.en-US: Initial volume from 0 to 100, read once when the player mounts.

width.zh-CN: 播放器宽度，数字按像素处理，字符串原样使用。
width.en-US: Player width; a number is in pixels, a string is used as is.

getVideo.zh-CN: 返回原生 video 元素，挂载前为 undefined。
getVideo.en-US: Returns the native video element, undefined before mount.
